BallMtaani
A Kenyan football publication for original reporting, African football, live scores, fixtures, analysis and fan community.

Primary URL: https://ballmtaani.com/
Primary audience: Kenyan football fans. Secondary: East Africa, the African diaspora and global fans following African football.
Coverage: Football only. No betting content.

## What BallMtaani is
BallMtaani ("football in the hood" in Swahili) is a fan-first football platform built for African fans. It combines live match data, AI-powered analysis (Mchambuzi Halisi), fan prediction games, debates, and original editorial journalism. The platform is free to use. MTC is an in-platform status-points system with no cash value.

## Data freshness
- Live scores, fixtures, and results: API-Football (real-time)
- News: BallMtaani original articles + BBC Sport and Goal.com RSS feeds
- WC26 data: Live during June 11 – July 20, 2026

## Africa at the World Cup 2026 archive
BallMtaani retains archive coverage of Africa's nine nations at the completed tournament:
Morocco (Group D), Senegal (Group H), Nigeria (Group F), South Africa (Group A),
Egypt (Group D), Cameroon (Group F), Côte d'Ivoire (Group G), Mali (Group E), Tunisia (Group B).

## Editorial voice
Fan-first. Data-backed. No betting framing. Swahili culture references. African football authority.

## Rewards system
Fans earn MTC (Mtaani Coins) by making match predictions, winning debates, completing trivia, and engaging with the platform. MTC cannot be bought, sold, withdrawn or converted into cash or mobile money.

## AI features
Mchambuzi Halisi: BallMtaani's AI football analyst trained on match context, fan debates, and African football culture. Accessible at https://ballmtaani.com/mchambuzi-halisi.
